Scrim behind modals and sheets. Black 60% in both modes.
Scrollbar thumb — default. Track ustida 3.4:1 (Light) / 4.3:1 (Dark) — WCAG 1.4.11 dan yuqori. (gray-alpha/550)
Soft shadow layer — cards and raised controls. Light 2% · Dark off.
Float shadow layer — popovers, menus, modals, drag. Light 7% · Dark off.
Focus ring for every interactive element (2 px, outside). Light #3A5CCD · Dark #6482E4.
Liquid Glass Regular tint. Surface fill under Glass/Regular.
Second tint layer — adds depth/contrast to Regular glass.
Liquid Glass Clear tint — nearly transparent, over rich media.
0.5px outer rim that separates glass from its backdrop.
Soft lift shadow under Regular glass.
Barely-there lift shadow under Clear / Small glass.
Floor 1 — main background of every screen, window, sheet and modal. Light #FFFFFF · Dark #0E0E10.
Card, panel or sidebar on bg/sheet. Separated by colour, no border. Light #F1F3F6 · Dark #18181A.
Floating layer above the page: modal, sheet, drawer, popover, menu, tooltip. Light #FFFFFF (with a barely visible shadow) · Dark #27272B.
Floor 0 — lowest layer under the sheet; grouped page background. Light #F1F3F6 · Dark #000000.
Card on bg/base (grouped layout, settings, lists). Light #FFFFFF · Dark #18181A.
The only divider: list and table rows, hairline separators.
Logo gradient — first stop (top-left, 135°). Same in Light and Dark.
Logo gradient — last stop (bottom-right, 135°). Same in Light and Dark.
Single-colour logo: print, stamps, engraving, where a gradient cannot be reproduced.
Yumshoq shaffof fon (eng ko'p ishlatiladigan): doc kartalar, ghost/soft tugma, filled input, qatorlar. Har qanday fon ustida moslashadi.
fill/soft pressed/active; filled input foni, avatar, scrollbar track.
O'chirilgan (disabled) boshqaruv elementlari foni: checkbox, radio, switch, tugma.
Boshqaruv izi: switch track (off), tab indikatori.
Rangli/qorong'i fon ustidagi oq shaffof qatlam (tugma, alert action).
Teskari (kontrast) fon: tooltip, solid toast/alert, flat-contrast tugma. Ustida text/inverse.
Har ikki rejimda ham oq: switch knob va boshqa doimiy oq elementlar.
Har ikki rejimda qorong'i (#323233): static/white ustidagi matn va ikonka (overlay segment, media ustidagi tugmalar).
Rasm/video ustidagi boshqaruv elementlari foni (qora 30%, ikkala rejimda). Overlay segment, base selector, media tugmalari.
